work.title: La Mer
work.movement: I. De l’aube à midi sur la mer

version.note: The LP identifies the orchestral work. The precise edition, editorial alterations and part materials used by Paray are not established; no La Mer brass variant is used as a timing anchor.

performers.note: Named on the original Mercury label and in the transfer metadata. Individual orchestra players are not identified.

date.note: The label’s later reissue documentation dates the La Mer/Ibéria sessions to 3–4 December 1955. No particular take is assigned to one of those days.

place.value: Old Orchestra Hall, Detroit, Michigan, United States
place.note: The label names the recording venue; the LP issue date and modern digitisation date are distinct.

label.note: Original mono LP imprint, not the label of a later CD reissue.

catalogue.note: The transferred US mono LP is catalogued by Internet Archive as a 1956 release.

matrixTakeSides.note: Side and band follow the label and segmented filenames. No runout matrix, stamper, session take or original tape number has been established.

credits.note: The operator account is transcribed as an account identifier, not expanded into an unverified personal or mastering credit.

date.note: Derived directly from the item’s ripping_date field, 20201121083807. The 2020-10-21 scan date is a separate event.

processing.value: Technics SL1200MK5 with Audio-Technica AT95e cartridge → RDL EZ-PH1 → Focusrite Scarlett 2i2; segmented VBR MP3 access derivative.
processing.note: The item documents the playback and digitisation chain. Equalisation settings, pitch correction, noise reduction and further restoration are not established.

digital.format: VBR MP3 derivative of a mono vinyl LP transfer

composition.value: Underlying Debussy composition is out of copyright under ordinary life-plus-70 terms; the original published score is historical.
composition.note: Debussy died in 1918. This is a term assessment of the composition, not a blanket clearance for unidentified modern editions or every jurisdiction.

recording.value: Rule 3 — territorial EU public domain: lawful commercial publication in 1956, before 1963.
recording.note: The 1956 Mercury mono LP publication predates 1963; under the programme’s rule its former 50-year phonogram term expired before the 2013 extension. First lawful publication anywhere is the relevant event; a US LP release can supply that date. US recording status is not established. This is not a Creative Commons licence or worldwide clearance.

rights.creditLine: Claude Debussy, La Mer — I. De l’aube à midi sur la mer; Detroit Symphony Orchestra, Paul Paray. Mercury MG 50101 (mono, 1956); Internet Archive LP transfer. Territorial EU public-domain basis; US recording status not established.
